name: AgentCanvas
objective: In diagrams.net, create a rectangle on the application canvas labeled exactly Vibe Maa from a fresh blank document, repeatably.
constraints: Use standard MaaFramework Pipeline actions only; no Shell, Command, or Custom actions.
Expose entry AgentTask through interface.json for normal MaaFW handoff.
Each run must create the result from a fresh blank document at 1280x720.
The AgentTask entry must handle both fresh start URLs without external setup inputs: splash=0 starts on a blank canvas and splash=1 starts with the Device modal.
For splash=1, dismiss the Device storage chooser with Change Storage then Decide Later, leaving no modal open.
The final canvas must contain exactly one rectangle labelled exactly Vibe Maa, and the established VibeMaaVisible completion condition must remain unchanged.
